newsitem.title: USA: Conn. says jobless rate firms to 5.2 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Conn. says jobless rate firms to 5.2 pct in Dec.

text.p: NEW YORK, Feb 6 (Reuter) The Connecticut State Labor Department said the jobless rate rose to 5.2 percent, one-tenth of a percent more than in November, and the first jump in several months.
The most job losses came in finance, insurance, and real estate, while there were increases in jobs in the service industry, government trade, and manufacturing.
The single hardest hit town was Danielson, which had an employment rate of 6.4 percent. Bridgeport, Waterbury, and New London were also above the state average.
The lowest figures were reported in Danbury and Stamford, which had rates of just above three-percent.
